description: Defines a template class JSONValueConverter for converting JSON data into C++ structs, including registration of various field types and nested structures.

classes.name: JSONValueConverter
classes.description: Template class for converting JSON values into C++ structs with registration methods for different field types.

methods.name: RegisterIntField
methods.description: Registers an integer field for JSON conversion.

methods.name: RegisterStringField
methods.description: Registers a string field for JSON conversion.

methods.name: RegisterBoolField
methods.description: Registers a boolean field for JSON conversion.

methods.name: RegisterDoubleField
methods.description: Registers a double (floating point) field for JSON conversion.

methods.name: RegisterNestedField
methods.description: Registers a nested struct field for JSON conversion.

methods.name: RegisterCustomField
methods.description: Registers a custom field with a user-defined conversion function.

methods.name: RegisterRepeatedString
methods.description: Registers a repeated string or u16string field.

methods.name: RegisterRepeatedMessage
methods.description: Registers a repeated nested message field.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts a JSON value into the specified struct type.
